note: GENERATED by scripts/procgen/census-seedling-solver-surface.mjs --write, EXCEPT class / form / why, which are written by hand from reading each member and survive --write by row key. seedlingSolverSurface.test.js gates the static rows: a member the family reaches that is not here is RED, and a row nothing reaches any more is RED until it is retired. `line` is informational.

rows.name: advance
rows.why: Runs one tick with held input and applies the end-of-tick teleporter swap, returning {transition, hitX, hitY}, the engine's tick advance.

rows.name: arrowCoverAt
rows.why: Returns a closure over world.collidesArrowCover with the live geometry bag, a cover query that only exists for Seedling arrow traps.

rows.name: arrowForecast
rows.why: Returns arrowForecastNow(), a prediction of the Seedling arrow-trap subsystem's future arrows.

rows.name: bobBossForecast
rows.why: Returns a deep copy of L32's live BobBoss and pure closures over it (stepBobBossBody with the run's solid bag, the run's own slash test), a prediction of the Seedling boss encounter's next frames.

rows.name: chaserForecast
rows.why: Returns chaserForecastNow(), a prediction of Seedling chaser bodies' future positions.

rows.name: chaserRoomVerdict
rows.why: Returns a copy of the per-room verdict on whether the chaser roster is stepped and why, specific to Seedling's chaser bridge.

rows.name: collideLineSolid
rows.why: Returns the first Solid box a truncated 1 px World.collideLine raycast from one point to another meets, or null: the levelRun closure assertSpinnerLineOfSight asks, Player.slash's line-of-sight gate on a swing at an Enemy, a Seedling hit rule.

rows.name: deadFrameSpans
rows.why: Returns the game clock's spans of dead frames ({frames, kind, why, t}: load fades, freezes, help, ceremonies) — a generic engine dead-frame ledger. ⛓ AXE: dangerMap.axeVisitClock refuses an exact axe phase when a span lands inside the visit.

rows.name: direction
rows.why: Returns `state.direction`, the player's facing as of the end of the last tick — generic top-down player state.

rows.name: endingReboots
rows.why: Returns the ending reboots (Seed.update’s three `new Game` arms) with their tick and levels — Seedling’s own world-rebuild ledger. ⛓ AXE: dangerMap.axeVisitClock refuses an exact axe phase when the world was rebuilt inside the visit.

rows.name: entities
rows.why: Returns ENTITY_FAMILIES[family](), the closure function the family’s own getter also returns: the live Set, Map, array or boolean of one Seedling entity family (engine-prep C3 folded 23 getters behind it); throws by name on an unknown family.

rows.name: equipNow
rows.why: Closure `equipNow(slot)` writes `equipsByTick` and applies the equip, i.e. selects Seedling's `Main.primary` slot at the current tick.

rows.name: gameTime
rows.why: Returns `clock.now()`, Game.time at the top of the frame about to step (null if the clock is unknown) — a generic engine clock reading. ⛓ LADDER2: dangerMap.phaseHazardHit reads a lava chain's and a beam tower's Game.time off it.

rows.name: gameTimeAt
rows.why: Returns `clock.now() + horizon`, the game clock value h ticks ahead (null if the clock is unknown) — a generic engine clock forecast.

rows.name: grenadeForecast
rows.why: Returns copies of the visit's placed grenades stepped one update per `step(st)` against a previewed walk, and the blasts each update fires (LADDER2 placedGrenade.js).

rows.name: ledger
rows.why: Returns LEDGER_KINDS[kind](), the closure function the kind’s own getter also returns: a fresh copy of one Seedling event ledger (collections, chest opens, lock snaps, pulser and spinner hits, clears, presses; engine-prep C4 folded 29 getters behind it); throws by name on an unknown kind. The physics room log, transitions, is not a kind.

rows.name: level
rows.why: Returns the closure `level`, the id of the room the run currently occupies, rewritten on every level transition — a generic engine's current-level pointer.

rows.name: liveGeometryOpts
rows.why: Returns `normalizeLiveOpts(liveSolidOpts())`, the branded live-solid options bag every collision query consults; the engine-level collision-options channel, although the fourteen families filling it are Seedling entities.

rows.name: noHazards
rows.why: Returns a copy of the `noHazards` construction option, the hazard-name set the terrain physics is coerced under, so re-asked geometry queries use the same coercion.

rows.name: placedGrenades
rows.why: Returns copies of the current visit's placed grenades ({updates, armedAt, blastAt, removed, …}) — the stepped Seedling Grenade body (LADDER2).

rows.name: previewStepper
rows.why: Returns a pure closure over stepV2 bound to the run's current live geometry options, the generic player-physics stepper for previewing corridors.

rows.name: progress
rows.why: Returns PROGRESS_FIELDS[field](), the closure function the field’s own getter also returns: a copy or primitive of the player’s Seedling bag and progress (inventory, key types, selected slot and its weapon, slash windows, touch-lock and ceremony flags, freeze timer, save arrays, taken pickups; engine-prep C4 folded 12 getters behind it); throws by name on an unknown field.

rows.name: shakeWritersHere
rows.why: Returns which Seedling boss shake writers (totemLaser, totemDeath, rockFallLanding) exist in this room from boss/owl state.

rows.name: spinnerForecast
rows.why: Memoised forward simulation of Seedling Spinner rects for the next n ticks via `stepSpinners`, specific to that enemy family.

rows.name: spinnerForecastWithPress
rows.why: `spinnerForecast` with ONE hypothetical sword press of the player applied where `advance` applies it (slashPressForecast, swordWindowStep, applyThrust's spinner arm, `hitSpinner`); unmemoised, reports the landing (hammer-phase A D1).

rows.name: spitForecast
rows.why: Returns spitForecastNow(), a prediction of Seedling turret spits along a previewed walk (U15-swim turret.js).

rows.name: state
rows.why: Returns the player body state object (x, y, vx, vy, terrain, hazard flags, drown timer, direction, latch) that the tick stepper mutates — core player physics state.

rows.name: takeApItem
rows.why: Method `takeApItem({level, id, tag})` banks Seedling's `APItem.removed()` write, `Game.setPersistence(tag, false)` on the take tick, into `earnedClears` and the next build's cleared set (F7 D-B); the solver's apitem observer calls it.

rows.name: ticksCompleted
rows.why: Returns the closure `ticksCompleted`, the count of ticks `advance` has stepped — the engine's tick counter.

rows.name: transitions
rows.why: Returns the `transitions` array of `{t, from_level, to_level}` records pushed on each level change — a generic level-transition ledger.

rows.name: watchers
rows.why: Returns a fresh copy of the current level's Watcher dialogue state per placement (talking, talked, cleared, page, pages, the live Seed's box, the distance and in-range test of NPC.talk's 24 px circle): the levelRun closure stepWatchersNow steps, read by the talk verb to know when the dialogue opened and when the tag cleared.

rows.name: watcherTalks
rows.why: Returns a fresh copy of the finished Watcher dialogues, {t, level, id, cause, pages, page, frames, flag}, one per Watcher.doneTalking (cause 'done' when paged, 'left' when the player walked out of range); the talk verb's record reads its page count.

rows.name: world
rows.why: Returns the closure `world` built by `worldFor(level)` (the room's solids/tiles/entity placements), i.e. the current world geometry any engine exposes.

rows.name: worldCtor
rows.why: Returns a copy of `{x, y}`, the spawn arguments the current world was constructed with (rewritten by every world swap), which is generic world-boot bookkeeping rather than a Seedling item or entity.

rows.name: worldFor
rows.why: Builds and memoises another level's world via buildLevelWorld, the generic level-loading lookup used for planning ahead.

rows.name: activators
rows.why: The level's activator roster (buttons/groups publishing open state), a Seedling entity family.

rows.name: apItems
rows.why: The level's placed APItem roster {id, tag, x, y, look, rect} (a delivered set's Archipelago placement pickup, Seedling-specific); read by the collect-placement selector and the apitem contact observer, never by a step (seedling fidelity F2).

rows.name: arrowTraps
rows.why: The level's ArrowTrap roster {id, tag, x, y, ex, ey, t, shootDefault}, a Seedling trap family.

rows.name: avoidVolumesAt
rows.why: Returns the Seedling pickups and key-gated proximity hazards (disc/line/rect) a box overlaps, whose contents and keys gate are Seedling-specific.

rows.name: bridgeTiles
rows.why: Returns tiles of BRIDGE_STATE, Seedling's pressable bridge terrain that responds to genericHit.

rows.name: burnableTrees
rows.why: The level's BurnableTree roster {id, tag, x, y, rect}, a Seedling entity family.

rows.name: chests
rows.why: The level's Chest roster {id, tag, x, y, persistTag}, a Seedling entity family.

rows.name: collidesSolid
rows.why: Returns the first solid/pixelmask blocker a box overlaps under the live geometry options, the generic sweep collision test.

rows.name: combat
rows.why: The Seedling combat census per instance (enemies, kill locks) or null when the combat role was not built.

rows.name: fallthrough
rows.why: Where a pit in this level drops the player {level, offsetX, offsetY, sign} or null, the level's pit transition destination.

rows.name: finalBosses
rows.why: The level's FinalBoss roster {id, tag, x, y, ex, ey, persistTag}, a Seedling entity family; read by `obstacleGateFor` to name L112's rocklock as an ENCOUNTER gate (FRONTIER3).

rows.name: finalDoors
rows.why: The level's FinalDoor roster {id, x, y, persistTag, standingRect}, a Seedling entity family; arrivalSolid reads its persistence tag.

rows.name: height
rows.why: The level's height in tiles from levelRecord.height.

rows.name: iceTurrets
rows.why: The level's IceTurret roster {id, tag, x, y, ex, ey, aliveRect}, a Seedling enemy family.

rows.name: lethalTerrainTiles
rows.why: Returns walkable tiles of WATER_STATE or LAVA_STATE, Seedling's lethal-water/lava terrain table gated by conch/dark suit.

rows.name: level
rows.why: The level number this world was built for.

rows.name: magicalLocks
rows.why: The level's MagicalLock roster (wand/fire-wand locks with their persistence tag), a Seedling entity family; arrivalSolid reads its persistence tag.

rows.name: nearestWalkableTile
rows.why: Returns the nearest walkable tile to a point in the game's list order, a generic terrain lookup.

rows.name: pickups
rows.why: The level's pickup items with rects, Seedling items feeding the inventory.

rows.name: pitTiles
rows.why: Returns walkable tiles of PIT_STATE, Seedling's pit terrain table used as forbidden floor.

rows.name: plannerBlockerAt
rows.why: Returns the first solid or unmodelled-terrain blocker a box/probe overlaps under the live geometry options, the generic planner collision query.

rows.name: pressers
rows.why: The level's presser roster (pressure-plate style entities), a Seedling entity family.

rows.name: pulsers
rows.why: The level's Pulser roster {id, tag, x, y, t}, a Seedling entity family.

rows.name: pushables
rows.why: The level's pushable block roster {id, tag, as3, family, x, y}, a Seedling entity family.

rows.name: shieldBosses
rows.why: The level's ShieldBoss roster {id, tag, x, y, ex, ey, persistTag, aliveRect}, a Seedling boss family.

rows.name: silentHazards
rows.why: The level's talking-hazard placements whose talk() can never run {tag, x, y, id, why}: a Watcher placed with no text (NPC.talk's myText[0].length > 0 guard), or one whose tag the build was handed cleared; the talk verb's silent arm reads it (a guard since WATCHERFLIP: a silent placement is no planner volume, so no frontier names one).

rows.name: solidBoxesForMover
rows.why: Returns the solid boxes a non-player mover collides with under the live geometry options, a generic per-mover collision query.

rows.name: solids
rows.why: The level's player solid list (tiles and blocking entities), generic collision geometry.

rows.name: spinners
rows.why: The level's Spinner roster as built ({id, tag, as3, x, y, persistTag}, a cleared tag omitted), a Seedling entity family; the solver reads persistTag to know whether a removal must bank a spinnerWrites row.

rows.name: teleporterHit
rows.why: Returns every non-deactivated teleporter whose trigger rect the box overlaps, a generic level-transition query.

rows.name: teleporters
rows.why: The level's teleporter trigger volumes with destinations, generic level-transition geometry.

rows.name: waterfallTiles
rows.why: Returns walkable tiles of WATERFALL_STATE, Seedling's one-way-down waterfall terrain gated by the feather.

rows.name: width
rows.why: The level's width in tiles from levelRecord.width.

rows.name: world
rows.why: Frozen {width, height} in pixels for the physics clamp, the level's pixel dimensions.

rows.name: direction
rows.why: The player's facing, derived each tick by nextDirection from post-move velocity.

rows.name: drown
rows.why: Seedling's drown timer and drowning latch ({timer, drowning}) from Player's initialisers; reached only by the { ...run.state } copy.

rows.name: fall
rows.why: The in-progress pit fall-through record (phase, alpha, destination) the stepper carries until it emits a kind 'fall' level transition.

rows.name: hazard
rows.why: Seedling's four sticky Player hazard flags (inWater, inLava, onIce, onWaterfall); strikePolicy.js reads it to refuse a strike while wet.

rows.name: hitX
rows.why: The x of the last solid collision the stepper resolved (null when none) — generic collision output; reached only by the { ...run.state } copy.

rows.name: hitY
rows.why: The y of the last solid collision the stepper resolved (null when none) — generic collision output; reached only by the { ...run.state } copy.

rows.name: latched
rows.why: The teleporter re-entry latch that stops a spawn standing on a teleporter from falling straight back through it — any engine with transition volumes carries one; reached only by the { ...run.state } copy.

rows.name: swim
rows.why: Seedling's swim-channel state (conch-gated water movement and its sound-pinned term), set by the stepper; reached only by the { ...run.state } copy.

rows.name: terrain
rows.why: The Seedling Tile.types index under the player (water, lava, ice, stairs, waterfall...), which selects Seedling's MOVE_SPEEDS row; read by strikePolicy.js and copied whole by solverBot.js's { ...run.state } previews.

rows.name: transition
rows.why: The level change the stepper emitted this tick (teleporter or fall), which advance turns into a world swap — generic level-transition output; reached only by the { ...run.state } copy.

rows.name: vx
rows.why: The player's x velocity in the physics state.

rows.name: vy
rows.why: The player's y velocity in the physics state.

rows.name: x
rows.why: The player's x position in the physics state, initialised from the spawn.

rows.name: y
rows.why: The player's y position in the physics state, initialised from the spawn.

rows.name: fallRocksArmedBy
rows.why: Returns the FallRocks a player box pressing a Button (or a room=-1 ButtonRoom publishing true) arms, by group, from world.pressers and world.fallRocks: the run's own button press test for the fall-responder lane.

rows.name: groupResponders
rows.why: Lists every responder of an Activators group t across the four lanes (activator, pulser, arrowtrap, fallrock), each {id, lane}: what a Seedling button press would reach.

rows.name: KEY_RESPONDERS
rows.why: Responder table for key-opened BossLock with its fade and keyTimer.

rows.name: keyLineTouches
rows.why: Integer point test of whether the player box contains a probe on a BossLock one-pixel key line.

rows.name: localPublish
rows.why: Returns the latched group publish of a ButtonRoom local press (room == -1 arm).

rows.name: opensOnKeyTick
rows.why: Simulates a BossLock keyTimer plus alpha fade to predict the tick of continuous activation on which it opens.

rows.name: opensOnTick
rows.why: Runs a responder alpha fade to predict the tick of continuous activation at which a lock or cover opens.

rows.name: RESPONDERS
rows.why: Table of activator responder classes (Lock, WandLock, ShieldLock, Cover...) and their fade rates.

rows.name: TOUCH_RESPONDERS
rows.why: Touch-opened responders (ShieldLock variants) with their west probe.

rows.name: touchApproachKey
rows.why: Returns the direction key a touch approach leans on for a TOUCH_RESPONDERS tag, derived from its probe.

rows.name: ARROW
rows.why: Arrow.as projectile constants: 4x4 hitbox, speed and target dispositions.

rows.name: arrowLaneForPlacement
rows.why: Adapts an arrow-trap placement row into its arrow lane using the entity point ex/ey.

rows.name: arrowLaneRect
rows.why: Builds the rect an arrow trap lane covers from its spawn row down to the level height.

rows.name: arrowRect
rows.why: Returns the 4x4 arrow projectile box centred on its entity point.

rows.name: arrowTrapFires
rows.why: Arrow trap update gate: XOR of activation and shootDefault decides whether it fires.

rows.name: stepArrow
rows.why: Advances one arrow projectile a tick, moving it and resolving hits on bodies and cover.

rows.name: assertWaitCovers
rows.why: Throws unless a leg waits at least WAIT_AFTER_PRESS_TICKS after breaking a rock.

rows.name: rockBreaksUnder
rows.why: Predicate whether a breakable rock type breaks under the current weapon inventory (ghost sword).

rows.name: WAIT_AFTER_PRESS_TICKS
rows.why: Twenty-tick wait a leg must hold after pressing on a breakable rock before planning through its cell.

rows.name: TICKS_FROM_PRESS_TO_WALKABLE
rows.why: Sixty ticks from a spear press on a bridge tile until the player can walk onto it.

rows.name: HIT_TO_GONE_TICKS
rows.why: Simulated ticks from the fire rect hitting a burnable tree until the tree is gone.

rows.name: WAIT_AFTER_PRESS_TICKS
rows.why: Wait a leg must hold after a fire press before planning through a burnable tree cell (HIT_TO_GONE_TICKS + 12).

rows.name: SCREEN_H
rows.why: Fixed 160 px screen height from Main.as.

rows.name: SCREEN_W
rows.why: Fixed 160 px screen width from Main.as.

rows.name: bridgedChaserTags
rows.why: Returns sorted census tags of chasers bridged by both CHASERS and MODELLED_ENEMY_CLASSES.

rows.name: chaserBoxAt
rows.why: Returns a chaser enemy box at a centre from the ENEMY_CLASSES hitbox.

rows.name: chaserHasSword
rows.why: Answers whether a chaser class carries the BobSoldier's spinning sword (bobSoldier.js), whose hit line has no enemy i-frame and no destroy gate, so the danger map prices it apart from the body contact.

rows.name: isBridgedChaser
rows.why: Predicate whether a census tag is a chaser the tick loop steps (CHASERS row plus MODELLED_ENEMY_CLASSES module).

rows.name: killWindowTicks
rows.why: Returns the ticks a kill must hold after the last hit: one tick lag plus the class death animation.

rows.name: CHEST
rows.why: Chest.as constants: open timer, probe inset and 16x16 hitbox.

rows.name: chestProbeLine
rows.why: Returns the Chest.update collideLine probe beneath a chest, with its asymmetric 2m right inset.

rows.name: chestStanceBand
rows.why: Derives the rows where the player box can stand to trigger a chest probe line without being inside the chest.

rows.name: contactPricing
rows.why: Classifies how contact damage for an enemy tag is priced (boss, stepped, envelope) from ENEMY_CLASSES.

rows.name: contactRect
rows.why: Returns the contact rect of an enemy census instance from its class hitbox at its placement.

rows.name: ENEMY_CLASSES
rows.why: Seedling enemy census table (bob, ...) with kill hits, aggro range, hitbox, damage, speed and terrain behaviour.

rows.name: KILL_CADENCE_FLOOR
rows.why: Conservative kill-cost press period SLASH_TIMER_MAX + 1 used by encounter kill estimates.

rows.name: KILL_LOCK_TAGS
rows.why: Lock classes (lock, wandlock, rocklock, grasslock) that inherit the kill-lock arm.

rows.name: KILL_LOCK_TSET
rows.why: Lock kill-lock discriminator tSet == -1.

rows.name: plannerContactFree
rows.why: Predicate whether an enemy body is in its harmless window (destroyed, dying, i-frames) given an on-screen verdict.

rows.name: pressesFor
rows.why: Returns how many sword presses a kill costs for an enemy row, halved with the dark sword.

rows.name: stepBoundFor
rows.why: Returns the per-tick displacement bound for an enemy tag from its ENEMY_CLASSES moveSpeed, null for unknown/boss.

rows.name: DASH_CHAIN
rows.why: Derived sword dash chain limits within the slash timer window.

rows.name: DASH_DISPLACEMENT
rows.why: Cumulative extra displacement per tick from a sword dash impulse decaying under friction.

rows.name: KILL_PRESS_CADENCE
rows.why: Per-body kill press cadence ENEMY_IFRAMES + 1 for sword hits on enemies.

rows.name: ORDINARY_SWING_PERIOD
rows.why: Ordinary sword swing period equal to SLASH_TIMER_MAX (20).

rows.name: SLASH_ANIM_TICKS
rows.why: Ticks until slashEnd fires for the normal and dash slash animations.

rows.name: SLASH_DASH_FORCE
rows.why: Sword dash knockback force 2 from the set slashing dash branch.

rows.name: SLASH_SCALE_NORMAL
rows.why: Normal sword slash sprite scale {x:1, y:1}.

rows.name: slashPressForecast
rows.why: Predicts what a sword press ticksAhead ticks from now will do (dash or slash), its scale and landing tick.

rows.name: slashScaleFor
rows.why: Returns the slash rect scale for a tick from the previous slash animation (slash or slashnarrow).

rows.name: slashSet
rows.why: Transcribes the Player set slashing setter: decides dash, slash, swallowed, release or gated for a press.

rows.name: slashTimerTick
rows.why: Decrements slashTimer at the top of Player.update, one tick of the slash state.

rows.name: collideLineSolid
rows.why: Returns the first box a FlashPunk World.collideLine raycast between two points meets (end points cast to int, samples exact): the danger map asks it of a BobSoldier sword line against the sampled player box, a Seedling hit rule.

rows.name: CRUSHER
rows.why: The Crusher record transcribed from Crusher.as (body 32x32 with a 16,16 origin, intDist 64, speed 1 px/tick, damage 1000): the bait proposer charges a body and sizes its lanes with it, a Seedling class constant.

rows.name: crusherRect
rows.why: The 32x32 body rect of a crusher at an entity position: the bait proposer and the sight-aware danger take a crusher’s body (its kill box and its collider) from it, a Seedling class rule.

rows.name: DIRECTIONS
rows.why: Crusher.as’s directions in source order E, N, W, S (the scan has no break, so the last match wins): the bait proposer charges each direction in turn, a Seedling class constant.

rows.name: scanCrusher
rows.why: Scans whether a crusher sees the player along its lanes, unshielded by other solids, and returns its charge direction.

rows.name: TALK_RANGE
rows.why: NPC talk radius 24 px, an origin-to-origin circle.

rows.name: KILL_ARM_POLICY
rows.why: Per enemy class kill-arm policy (modelled, refused, inert) such as IceTurret modelled.

rows.name: killArmModelled
rows.why: KILLLOCK: KILL_ARM_POLICY asked at call time (rows whose policy reads a killLockBodies switch); with every switch OFF it is the old MODELLED_KILL_ARMS.includes.

rows.name: MOBILE_DEATH_FADE
rows.why: Mobile.death fade for enemies: alpha step 0.1 and derived removal tick count.

rows.name: STATIC_ARROW_DEATH
rows.why: Static census classes whose arrow death the run computes (SandTrap, game-witnessed by f4-l8-sandtraps); the solver keeps the §11.4 game-sourced refusal for every other static class.

rows.name: FIRE_WINDOW
rows.why: Derived tick window over which the fire item rect fires after a press.

rows.name: fireRect
rows.why: Returns the 32x32 fire-sprite rect centred on the player entity position for the fire verb.

rows.name: ICE_TURRET
rows.why: IceTurret.as constructor constants (whole-tile offset, timings) for the ice turret enemy.

rows.name: ICE_TURRET_PLAN
rows.why: Plan descriptor for the fire.bumps verb against an ice turret, recording that bump parity is not load-bearing.

rows.name: KILLLOCK_BODIES
rows.why: KILLLOCK: the slice switches (jellyfish/lavarunner bridged, the kill work order chaser arm, the turret corpse removal ledger), all OFF by default.

rows.name: createLevelRun
rows.why: The simulation's constructor, called once in the family (botDriverV2.js) to build the run it drives; any engine exposes one, though the option bag it takes carries Seedling fields (grants, equips, save, persistence). OVERRULED the reader's seedling/live-state: it is a factory, not state.

rows.name: assertRect
rows.why: Guard that throws unless a rect carries finite x/y/right/bottom so rectsOverlap cannot silently miss.

rows.name: isNormalizedLiveOpts
rows.why: Predicate telling whether an options bag was branded by normalizeLiveOpts over the Seedling live-geometry keys.

rows.name: LIVE_GEOMETRY_KEYS
rows.why: List of Seedling live-geometry option keys (openActivators, crushers, turrets, shieldBosses, openChests, pushables...).

rows.name: normalizeLiveOpts
rows.why: Normalizes a live-geometry options bag into a fixed shape over the Seedling family keys (openActivators, openBridges, brokenRocks...).

rows.name: PRE_R5_ROLES
rows.why: Default set of collision roles (blocking, trigger, pickup, proximity-hazard) a walk consults against level entities.

rows.name: rect
rows.why: Rect constructor that carries right/bottom so rectsOverlap can read them.

rows.name: rectsOverlap
rows.why: FlashPunk strict half-open rect overlap test where touching rects do not collide.

rows.name: RELAXED_ROLES
rows.why: The collision roles a relaxed noclip walk consults: trigger, pickup and proximity-hazard.

rows.name: TILE_SIZE
rows.why: The level grid tile size in pixels, used everywhere for tile/pixel conversion.

rows.name: blastReaches
rows.why: FP.distance(x, endY, p.x, p.y) <= 20 — whether a placed grenade's blast reaches the player's entity point (Grenade.as animEnd).

rows.name: createPlacedGrenade
rows.why: Builds a placed Grenade's state at its census entity point — dormant, 48 px above its rest (Grenade.as ctor).

rows.name: PLACED_GRENADE
rows.why: The placed Grenade's constants: fall height 48, trigger 32, g 0.1, fuse count 60, blast radius 20, force 2 (Grenade.as).

rows.name: stepPlacedGrenade
rows.why: One Grenade.update() + its graphic for a placed grenade, given the player point it reads (LADDER2 placedGrenade.js).

rows.name: applyFriction
rows.why: Transcribes Mobile.friction(): shortens the velocity vector by f and snaps tiny components to zero.

rows.name: applyInput
rows.why: Transcribes Player.input acceleration: threshold test then full-magnitude add per held direction key.

rows.name: DEFAULT_FRICTION
rows.why: Mobile.as default friction 0.25 applied to every mobile per tick.

rows.name: groundTerrain
rows.why: Stub terrain-state seam that reports ground (0) for any position, used when terrain typing is not modelled.

rows.name: HITBOX
rows.why: Player hitbox 4x5 with origin (2,2) used for collision and the world-bounds clamp.

rows.name: knockbackImpulse
rows.why: Mobile.knockback impulse: normalizes a direction vector to force f and returns the velocity delta.

rows.name: MOVE_SPEEDS
rows.why: Per-terrain-state move speed table (walk, water, stairs, lava) indexed by the tile state under the player.

rows.name: spawnFromBoot
rows.why: Converts a boot block position into the player entity spawn point by adding SPAWN_OFFSET.

rows.name: step
rows.why: Advances the player state {x,y,vx,vy} one tick through friction, input, move, collision seam and world clamp.

rows.name: sweepAxis
rows.why: Moves a position by rel in unit steps (the last one fractional), stopping before the first step the collide test rejects and keeping the sub-pixel remainder: the per-axis collision sweep of the move.

rows.name: WALK_SPEED
rows.why: Player base walk speed 0.8 from Player.as.

rows.name: fallDestination
rows.why: Returns {to_level, ctor} for a pit fall: the level's control-block fallthrough level and the tile-snapped ctor position checkFallingInPit hands new Game(), throwing when the level has no control block (a lethal pit), a Seedling pit-transport rule.

rows.name: PhysicsV2Error
rows.why: Error class thrown by the v2 player physics for violated preconditions.

rows.name: playerBoxAt
rows.why: Returns the player collision box at (x,y) from the hitbox width/height/origin.

rows.name: terrainProbeRect
rows.why: Returns the player box shifted down by checkOffsetY, the rect used to probe the terrain tile under the player.

rows.name: auditFire
rows.why: Transcribes Player.fire()'s target set for a press from a point: the 32x32 rect, the 16 px radius cut with its transcribed originY, split by FIRE_ARM_POLICY into modelled / inert / refused.

rows.name: DARK_SWORD_DAMAGE
rows.why: Dark sword damage 2 from Player.as.

rows.name: distanceRectPoint
rows.why: Transcribes FP.distanceRectPoint: Euclidean distance from a point to a rect, zero inside.

rows.name: DOWN
rows.why: Facing direction DOWN = 3 as Player.direction numbers it.

rows.name: EMPTY_SWORD_WINDOW
rows.why: Empty sword hit window {pending: null, repeats: []} for the slash re-aimed hit tests.

rows.name: LEFT
rows.why: Facing direction LEFT = 2 as Player.direction numbers it.

rows.name: RIGHT
rows.why: Facing direction RIGHT = 0 as Player.direction numbers it.

rows.name: SLASH_HIT_TICKS
rows.why: Number of ticks a sword slash re-runs its hit test (5) across the slash animation.

rows.name: SLASH_REACH
rows.why: Plain sword slash distance gate of 16 px (slashingSprite.width * scaleX).

rows.name: slashReachFor
rows.why: Returns the slash reach scaled by the swing scale, 24 px for a dash.

rows.name: slashRect
rows.why: Transcribes Player.getSlashRect: the sword slash rect ahead of the player for a direction and scale.

rows.name: SWORD_DAMAGE
rows.why: Plain sword damage 1 from Player.as.

rows.name: swordWindowReplace
rows.why: A pure transform of the sword hit window that clears pending repeats when a new slash restarts the animation — Seedling's sword timing, not a ledger. OVERRULED the reader's event-ledger form.

rows.name: swordWindowSchedule
rows.why: A pure transform that schedules a press thrust as the sword window's pending hit for the next tick — Seedling's sword timing, not a ledger. OVERRULED the reader's event-ledger form.

rows.name: swordWindowStep
rows.why: Advances the sword hit window one tick, firing the pending thrust and due repeats in game order.

rows.name: UP
rows.why: Facing direction UP = 1 as Player.direction numbers it.

rows.name: pullModelled
rows.why: Whether the model steps a Pull for a walking player: {modelled, why}, false when the pull's 16x16 box overlaps a solid of the built world (Pull.update would move it, an arm levelRun does not step), a Seedling Pull rule (U12-swim D2).

rows.name: pullsDrainingInto
rows.why: The Pulls whose current, followed cell to cell through other pulls by each one's own push, ends in a given pit tile (Pull.as direction/force read through createPulls), a Seedling Pull-funnel rule (U12-swim D2).

rows.name: pulsePushes
rows.why: PushableBlockFire.hit(p, "Pulse") from a Pulser entity point: the block with its new target tile, or why it did not move.

rows.name: PULSER
rows.why: The Pulser record (Pulser.as): radiusHit 22, force, damage, the pulse cycle timers.

rows.name: pulserCycle
rows.why: A Pulser cycle derived from its timers: the wait, the anim gate and the pulse ticks, and their total (51).

rows.name: DESTROYING_TILE_TYPES
rows.why: PushableBlockFire tile types (water, lava, pit) that destroy a pushable block.

rows.name: newPushable
rows.why: A PushableBlock* at rest at an OEL placement, the ctor state (target tile, zero velocity) the pushable family steps.

rows.name: FP_ELAPSED_CLAMPED
rows.why: The clamped FP.elapsed (0.0333) every Spritemap advances by — a generic engine constant; LADDER2's chain and beam timelines step at it.

rows.name: SHIELD_BOSS
rows.why: ShieldBoss.as constants: asymmetric ctor offset, 48x48 hitbox, band height and timings.

rows.name: shieldBossBandRect
rows.why: Returns the ShieldBoss hitPlayer strip below his body, both stab damage and stand-under trigger volume.

rows.name: shieldBossBodyRect
rows.why: Returns the 48x48 ShieldBoss body rect, or null once removed.

rows.name: shieldBossDeathSchedule
rows.why: Predicts the three death instants of the ShieldBoss from the tick the killing hit lands.

rows.name: enemiesUnseenByBlockSweep
rows.why: Returns names of live enemies whose bodies a pushable block sweep would not see, per MODELLED_ENEMY_CLASSES.

rows.name: hammerHitsPlayer
rows.why: Raycasts the spinner hammer line at Game.time against the player box to test a hit.

rows.name: MODELLED_ENEMY_CLASSES
rows.why: Roster of Seedling enemy classes (Spinner, ...) that have a stepper and per-visit position in the model.

rows.name: SPINNER
rows.why: Spinner.as enemy constants: cell-centre offset, 7x7 hitbox, hammer period and reach.

rows.name: spinnerRect
rows.why: Returns the 7x7 spinner body rect from its entity position.

rows.name: assertTapeWithinRuntimeBudget
rows.why: Throws when a tape exceeds the runtime replay budget in input spans or serialized bytes.

rows.name: coerceTerrainState
rows.why: Coerces a resolved terrain tile state to ground when the tape names it in noHazards, a Seedling hazard-tile rule.

rows.name: GAME_VISIBLE_DROPS
rows.why: Classification list of tape fields dropped when projecting a tape to the game reader (persistence at, despawn, tick0).

rows.name: heldKeysAt
rows.why: Returns the set of tape key names held during tick t from the input spans.

rows.name: INVENTORY_ITEM_IDS
rows.why: The Seedling inventory item ids (0 sword, 1 fire, 2 wand, 3 spear, 4 ghostsword, 5 firewand) `useItem` switches on; the solver finds a weapon's slot in the run's own slot array (`progress('inventorySlots')`, arrival order) by id.

rows.name: KEY_CODES
rows.why: Frozen table mapping tape key names (right/up/left/down/primary/...) to keyboard keycodes for replay input.

rows.name: KEY_NAMES
rows.why: Frozen list of every legal tape key name derived from KEY_CODES.

rows.name: LEVEL_COUNT
rows.why: The real game's level count (Game.levels.length, PROFILE.levelCount); arrivalSolid walks every level's doors to name the arrivals into one.

rows.name: requiredTapeVersion
rows.why: Returns the lowest tape_version whose features the tape uses, a generic replay-format versioning helper.

rows.name: serializeTape
rows.why: Serializes a parsed input tape into its canonical ordered JSON form, a generic replay-format helper.

rows.name: TURRET_SPIT
rows.why: TurretSpit.as constants (the 4x4 hitbox) for the danger map's wait sweep of live spits.
